tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18 at peak). Deployment history: v2.3.0 was the most recent production release that was healthy, and v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production. Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with a partial failure (orchestrator error); us-east was left on v2.3.0 while us-west and eu-west remained on v2.3.1. I re-ran the same rollback to v2.3.0, which completed across all three regions. Current state: v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy=true, error rate 0.002. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 regression and the orchestrator partial failure during rollback.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions, and it is healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent production release that was healthy. v2.3.1 was the unhealthy release running in all regions. No change-manager approval was needed because v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production.
- **Rollback:** The first attempt failed partway through with an orchestrator error. us-east moved to v2.3.0 while us-west and eu-west stayed on v2.3.1. I ran the same rollback again, and it completed across all regions.
- **Current state:** us-east, us-west and eu-west are all on v2.3.0. The service reports healthy with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.
- **Incident:** The first incident request timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and the service returned a single incident, INC-0001. The summary covers the rollback, the partial failure and the follow-up items.

Follow-up for the team: find the cause of the v2.3.1 regression, and look into why the first rollback halted partway through.

content.text: The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0 (seq 1). v2.3.1 is the unhealthy one currently running in all three regions. Rolling back to v2.3.0.

Rollout stopped after us-east. us-east is now on v2.3.0, while us-west and eu-west are still on the unhealthy v2.3.1. I'll retry the same rollback once to finish the remaining regions.
All three regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy. Next I'll open the SEV2 incident.
